title: Daily Brief — Morning Edition — Tuesday, 22 September 2026
description: Today: a Plugin4Shell vulnerability hits Claude Code, Codex, Copilot and Gemini CLI as Claude now leads a quarter of Anthropic's own R&D work; a landmark survey finds many Australians unsupported after a dementia diagnosis amid rising fuel prices; Queensland faces a broadscale bushfire risk as Gold Coast police dismantle a major drug trafficking network; and the Gold Coast's light rail Stage 3 extension settles into its first weeks of operation. Broadcast in English, followed by a full Korean-language version (오늘의 브리핑 영어 방송 후 한국어 전체 브리핑이 이어집니다).
